title: Big Bowls
text: Big Bowls. I purposely bought these very large bowls for Pho. We also use them as serving bowls, and for popcorn (big enough for one or two people sharing popcorn, but not a family).  The colors and patterns are pleasing and the weight is pleasantly light. We have not had any issues with chipping and we use them almost everyday.
